title: Stereochemical Specificity of Lamoxirene, the Sperm-Releasing Pheromone in Kelp (Laminariales, Phaeophyceae)
why: Laminariales: a test of which stereoisomers of lamoxirene release sperm in kelps; a living gametophyte's release of sperm in response to the pheromone is a response to a chemical cue under point 10(a). The species tested were not seen, and Nereocystis luetkeana or Egregia menziesii may be among them. Returned by the search "Nereocystis pheromone lamoxirene sperm release gametophyte".
